title: E0066: Header injection
plain_english: This rule reports HTTP header-related calls where user-controlled input reaches the header value. Crafted input containing CR/LF characters can be used to inject additional headers or manipulate the response.
why_matters: Header injection can lead to response splitting, cache poisoning, unsafe redirects, session-related issues, or other header manipulation vulnerabilities depending on the context.
what_it_checks: Cases where user-controlled input reaches these calls, based on taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
